ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; approximately 0.05:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid low-intensity (black) field across 95% of visible surface area. Localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing water droplets are distributed across the central and lower regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees, showing a narrow depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude saw-tooth serrations on the left lobe trailing edge. Irregular, lower-frequency undulations on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe trailing edge follows a linear-to-convex trajectory. Right lobe trailing edge follows a convex trajectory terminating in a rounded, thickened distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-contrast, roughly circular pixels with high intensity (white/yellowish) on the distal tip of the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular-textured protrusion and high-intensity pixel accumulation (barnacle colony) on the far right distal edge of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly jagged, step-like serration pattern on the proximal portion of the left lobe trailing edge near the median notch.
